name: smwmusic-tasogare-sakaba-uwabami-breakers-festiv-al-coholically
title: Tasogare Sakaba ~Uwabami Breakers~ - Festiv-al-coholically
description:
The stage 1 and 2 boss theme from Uwabami Breakers, a Touhou-but-not-really game set in a bar.

It's a fairly short song, but it packs quite a punch. Probably best suited for quick, low-stakes early-game bosses.

Originally ported for Superfamicompo 3.
